primary_read.q_source: Condon 2007 (reliable detection), as quoted in Rahman 2016 eq. 3
primary_read.framework: Condon 1974, ApJ 188, 279 (P(D) formalism; scan-only, framework cross-verified via Bond et al. quoting Condon's effective-solid-angle definition)
primary_read.misattribution_found: C1's 'q = 23.6 beams per source' column implemented N Omega = 23.6 sources per beam as the cutoff depth — not a Condon convention
primary_read.nvss_anchor: 0.45 mJy at 45 arcsec is the NVSS rms noise (Condon et al. 1998), not its confusion limit; corrected 45-arcsec confusion under the same law/criterion is ~0.19 mJy, so NVSS is noise-limited

vernstrom_xcheck.note: Vernstrom et al. 2014 abstract: rms confusion ~1.2 uJy/beam at 3 GHz, 8 arcsec
vernstrom_xcheck.note2: Condon-2007 faint counts (gamma=1.9, k=1000, 1.4 GHz, q=5) give ~2.8 uJy at 8 arcsec; the factor ~2 gap to the Vernstrom 3-GHz value is the count-normalization uncertainty C1 already flagged

verdict.ordering_at_6arcsec: confusion-dominated under the corrected Condon reading (3.5 vs thermal 0.41); classical still reads thermal-dominated (0.35 vs 0.41) — ordering remains formalism-dependent, spread narrows from 0.35-8 to 0.35-3.5
